instruction: Studio photograph, full shot, high angle. In a minimalist white studio, the dancer in the white outfit (R2) on the left bends deeply forward with arms extended, while the dancer in the black outfit (R1) on the right leans backward with arms outstretched. They perform a dynamic, non-contact contemporary dance pose, creating contrasting diagonal lines. Bright, clean studio lighting casts soft, distinct shadows on the white floor, emphasizing the high-contrast black and white palette.
elements: R2 bends deeply forward with arms extended while R1 leans backward with arms outstretched
R1 performs the backward-leaning part of the pose rather than the forward-bending part
R2 performs the deep forward bend rather than the backward lean
R1 and R2 maintain a dynamic non-contact contemporary dance pose
minimalist white studio setting with soft shadows on the white floor
